card: Parallelizes BIP 157/158 compact block filter evaluation across worker threads during wallet fast rescans. Introduces the -walletpar configuration option to set wallet thread count (auto-detecting up to 15 worker threads by default) while falling back to serial rescan during Initial Block Download. Previously, block filter evaluation was single-threaded, taking minutes to scan long block ranges during wallet imports, restores, or loading out-of-sync wallets. In author benchmarks scanning 200,000 mainnet blocks, runtime dropped from 272 seconds serially to 38 seconds at 8 threads and 25 seconds at 16 threads.
changed_since_previous: Added unit test coverage for resuming scans when the chain tip extends past the wallet's processed block during a scan (`scan_for_wallet_transactions_resume_after_tip`), and added functional test assertions verifying serial fallback during IBD.
evidence: Author's mainnet benchmark scanning 200,000 blocks on an Intel Core Ultra 7 265 reduced scan time from 272.2 seconds (serial / 1 thread) to 38.0 seconds at 8 threads and 25.3 seconds at 16 threads (PR description).
problem: Compact block filter checks during fast wallet rescans run sequentially on a single thread. On multi-core systems, scanning wide block ranges during wallet imports, restores, or node startup leaves CPU cores idle and takes minutes.

risk.why: Threading or synchronization mistakes in filter evaluation or block queueing could fail to detect wallet transactions, resulting in incorrect balances or missed UTXOs.

scope_notes: Touches core wallet scan infrastructure (`src/wallet/scan.cpp` and `scan.h`) to implement a parallel filter-checking thread pool with dynamic window resizing around keypool top-ups.
summary: Parallelizes BIP 157/158 compact block filter evaluation across worker threads during wallet fast rescans. Adds the `-walletpar` configuration option (defaulting to auto-detected CPU cores up to 15 dedicated threads) to control wallet worker thread count, falling back to serial scans during Initial Block Download. Also closes a race window when syncing blocks disconnected during a scan by checking chain activity under `cs_wallet`.
